name: Marie
source:
A mysterious girl who appears in [url=https://vndb.org/c22060]Ren[/url]'s dreams. She is clearly not Japanese, but her background and true name are unknown. For all we know, she might be just a figment of the young man's imagination. A maiden of the twilight, she sings a loathed refrain with a pure, angelic smile. Could that scar across her neck have been left by a guillotine?

"I shall hate and love you."

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1986219362/dies-irae-english-localization-project-commences/description]Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page[/url]]
